title: Retractable Hooks And Garment Rod Wall Mount 2-1/2-Inch Solid Brass Carolina | Shaded Beige | Allied Brass
short_title: Retractable Hooks And Garment Rod Wall Mount 2-1/2-Inch | Allied Brass
description:
Add space-saving hanging room with this wall mount retractable hook/garment rod that pulls out for 2-1/2 inches of hanging space, then pushes back in when not needed in Shaded Beige, which offers sophisticated warmth in a soft, neutral tone that complements natural materials and earthy palettes.

Highlights:
- Shaded Beige transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Holds up to 15 lb for coats, robes, and towels
- Wall mount design helps keep items within reach while saving floor space
- Part of the Carolina collection for coordinated bathroom hardware

Specs & Installation:
- Material: brass
- Mounting: wall mount; fits standard interior walls
- Installation requires drilling one 3/4-inch diameter hole through drywall plus three small holes around
- Hardware included: toggle bolts (6/32 toggles)
- Dimensions: 3.75-inch W x 1.75-inch H x 1.75-inch L; 1-inch projection
- Product weight: 1 lb
- Assembly required: no
- Finish options available across multiple designer finishes, including statement colors
